candidates.title: Prefer genuine moving stock when a direct match exists

examples.comment: Default still and hero slides must look like natural photographic frames that match the surrounding stock footage. Avoid gold fog, heavy volumetric haze, silhouetted figures, theatrical fantasy lighting, and visibly synthetic staging unless explicitly requested.

Still-image training from 2026-07-14: acquire genuine stock slides first, then choose the closest related selected stock-video frame and use that exact frame as the generated still's visual reference. Every still receives the full natural-photo, exposure/detail, depth/background, internal-motion, practical-light, grade, and grain treatment; preserve supplied originals, reject pan/zoom-only slides, keep all still-derived time inside the 35% cap, and fall back to genuine footage rather than emit an unreferenced generated still.

Other Versions of You was fully rejected. Start ordinary videos from genuine literal stock footage for every scene. Avoid multiple unrelated faces; prefer consistent hands, rear views, objects, places, and physical actions. Do not use deterministic symbolic graphics, generic low-grade graphics, hero images, or stills unless exact stock searching has genuinely failed and James explicitly accepts a substantially higher-grade fallback. Narrative correspondence and premium photographic realism outrank abstract visual cleverness.

STANDING RULE (fallback visuals): when genuine stock footage cannot be found for a scene, the pipeline auto-generates an APPEALING SPECIAL-EFFECTS STILL IMAGE that represents the line (via hero.py effects style) — never a plain text/label graphic box. Implemented in storyline_footage._render_storyboard.

Hand/cane fusion looks synthetic and risks malformed fingers. Replace with real stock footage of a gloved hand using a cane or tool, emphasizing repeated controlled motion; no morphing, dissolving, or exposed fingers.
